# tu 1.1.6 — fits small terminals, fixes non-UTF-8 locales

## What's new since `v1.1.5`

- **Session list fixed under `LANG=C` / an unset locale.** tmux rewrites
  tabs and non-ASCII bytes in its output to `_` when the locale isn't
  UTF-8, so tu showed *no sessions at all* and Korean names came back
  as `____`. Common on servers and Raspberry Pi OS. tu now asks tmux
  for UTF-8 output on every call.
- **Small terminals get the full window.** The 60 % window (a popup
  over the live panes inside tmux) is kept only while it still fits
  word labels and four list rows — a terminal of at least 99 × 22.
  An editor's terminal panel or an 80 × 24 window now gets the whole
  screen instead of a cramped box. Resizing outside tmux switches
  live; inside tmux the popup and the status-bar button pick the size
  from the client.
- **Labels only shrink as the terminal does.** Five stages at the
  default size: reduced window with full labels (`Attach (a)`, 129+
  columns), reduced window with word labels (`Attach`, 99-128), full
  window with word labels (60-98), key boxes (36-59), bare keys (≤ 35).
  `--size 100` still gives full labels wherever they fit.
- **Wide names line up.** Session names are padded and cut by
  terminal cells, so Hangul / CJK names no longer push their row past
  the list border.
- The managed tmux file moves to v2 (the size-aware status-bar
  binding) and is refreshed silently on first launch.

## Install

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hungryZoo/tu/main/install.sh | sh
```

Already on 1.1.3 or later? Press **u** in `tu`.
